title: Livestream Concert Deals: Here’s How to Get Nearly 70% Off of the Nugs Streaming Service
summary: Get three months of access for just $5 per month to watch concerts from Bruce Springsteen, Metallica, Dead & Company, Pearl Jam, Jack White, Phish and others.
contentText:

The music and live concert streaming service Nugs.net is offering fans a hefty markdown, as part of its annual summer sale. And if you’re a fan of live music, then this is a deep discount you won’t want to miss.

$5/month $14.99/month 67% off

Get Nugs

The plan gives music lovers access to exclusive concert livestreams, full-concert videos on-demand, official concert audio in MP3/AAC formats, 15% off purchases and other perks.

Nugs Summer Sale

Buy Now at Nugs.net

A 3-month subscription to Nugs.

The streaming service features hundreds of livestream concerts, exclusive bonus interviews, curated playlists and much more. It even has a catalog of past concerts from recording artists, like Bruce Springsteen, Metallica, Billy Strings, Dave Matthews Band, Dead & Company, Goose, Johnny Blue Skies, Pearl Jam, Jack White, Phish and others.

The beauty of the service is you can stream official concerts and exclusive livestreams, all for less than the price of a ticket. The livestreams are high quality with impressive audio that makes you feel like you’re front and center at the concert itself.

Additionally, Nugs is now available on Google TV, Roku, Apple TV and Amazon Fire TV with a streaming app for smart TVs. The service is also available for iPhone, iPad, Android smartphones and tablets, Sonos, web browsers and other devices. Now fans have more platforms to watch their favorite bands, singers and recording artists live online.
